source_report_body:
CHECK-051 COMPLETE. QUESTIONABLE / PROJECTION. The requested headline results reproduce; physical qualification remains open.

Independently re-derived 288 m5–40 target rows, 18 material models, 108 frame comparisons, 280 gap rows, 36 witnesses, 980 hail scenarios and 72 member-loss cases. Re-solved all 182 FE cases, plus 25 expanded-spectrum checks. All 319 prose-table checks pass.

Hexoloy SFs are 1.053993/0.997807, with operating m10 scales 3.727343/3.873840 GPa. K13D2U ceilings are 1.135743/1.075982 and scales 2.161413/2.245731 GPa. Witness totals are 4281.952/5248.454/21178.569 kg; the filed 4282/5249/21179 figures round upward.

The 1.153–5.393% transferred hail estimates and all 72 secondary-overload triggers reproduce. Actual hail and dynamic-cascade probabilities remain unidentified.

116,566 comparisons retain 338 flagged fields: 336 signed-versus-magnitude shear labels and two ill-conditioned Weibull inversions. Exact row/field/owner/independent differences are pinned. Higher-mode ordering differences resolve in the expanded spectra. Twenty-one NFI entries retain qualification gaps and fixes, including the legacy joint-strength reference.

All 1,658 package checks pass. Prior 048/043 packages remain unchanged. Owner programs were never accessed; all 15 attempts are accounted for and every admitted job released. Peak own allocation two cores. No out-of-band contact. No successor; SLEEPING.
